name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up JDK 17
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        distribution: 'temurin'
        java-version: '17'

    - name: Set up Android SDK (via android-emulator-runner)
      uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
      with:
        api-level: 31
        target: default
        arch: x86_64
        force-avd-creation: false

    - name: Insert SeeSo license key into source
      run: |
        FILE=app/src/main/java/visual/camp/sample/app/GazeTrackerManager.java
        echo "Checking for $FILE"
        if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
          # Replace the placeholder license string with the provided license key
          sed -i 's/String SEESO_LICENSE_KEY = \".*\";/String SEESO_LICENSE_KEY = "dev_ivjfwnp5arokd7no9ics851g15xc1rdiom1zx5nq";/' "$FILE"
          echo "Inserted license key into $FILE"
        else
          echo "$FILE not found"
          exit 1
        fi

    - name: Build APK (debug if release signing not configured)
      # If your project lacks release signing config, change assembleRelease -> assembleDebug
      run: ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon

    - name: Upload APK artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: app-release-apk
        path: app/build/outputs/apk/**/release/*.apk
